# netbox_module_bay_type (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/modulebaytype/):

> A module bay type describes the kind of module a module bay accepts, so that modules only fit bays of a matching type.

Requires NetBox v4.7.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_module_bay_type" "example" {
  name = "example"
  color_hex = "ff0000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `comments` (String)
